lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Kiko! There you are! We have a complete disaster on our hands!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: What happened? Is the portfolio missing?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: The Master Cover page is gone! Without Enzo's design, the NSPC judges won't even open our portfolio!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: We tore the entire publication office apart searching for it. It's a complete mess—if Mrs. Santos sees it, we're finished!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Did Enzo leave a physical backup anywhere else?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Yes! He mentioned storing a backup USB drive inside the old 'AP Style Guide 2018' in the Upper Library reference section!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Please, head over to the Library, find the drive, and meet me back here!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I'm on it. I'll search the Library and bring the drive right back.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I'm keeping watch outside the Admin office! Head upstairs to the Library and check the AP Style Guide!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Kim! I found Enzo's backup USB in the library reference shelf!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Thank goodness! Now you need to format and finalize the Master Portfolio on the computer.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Mrs. Santos is inside the publication office right now. Go ask her for permission to use the workstation!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: On my way. I'll speak with Mrs. Santos and get this printed.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Go to the publication office and talk to Mrs. Santos so you can use the workstation!
